department.instructions: Which team should handle this support ticket?

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, payment methods, prices already paid
criteria.technical: Bugs, errors, crashes, sync or login problems
criteria.account: Account ownership, passwords, deletion, merging accounts
criteria.sales: Buying, quotes, discounts, contracts for new purchases

criteria: Critical: outage or money being lost right now

is_refund.instructions: Is the customer asking for a refund?

criteria.true: The customer asks for money back
